status: 96 source/mechanism-reviewed train tasks assembled; real official CPU tool/verifier demonstrations and Gemma action-prefix exports underway. Human off-policy only; no on-policy rollout, critical pairs or GPU training. Exact live counts in vfarl/pilot96/manifest.json and vfarl/replay/replay-summary.json.

quantity_definition.task: Unique issue/repair family after exact/near-duplicate dedup. Shared-base tasks need not be one task, but their snapshot/related repair families must stay in the same use partition.
quantity_definition.trajectory: Actual recorded actions and observations with source verification. One successful trajectory per task initially; slicing does not create new tasks.
quantity_definition.supervised_tokens: Assistant text/tool calls that actually enter loss; tool outputs and prompts are masked by default. Counts are not total training processed tokens.

cold_start.curriculum: Shared six-tool course for all four adapters; G additionally covers all mechanisms. Rank/target-incompatible G and expert checkpoints are independently trained.
cold_start.assistant_mask: Only adjudicated, execution-supported action spans are positive targets; errors may remain in conditioning history.

baseline.assignment: Collect with designated owner adapter; not a paired specialist-versus-G efficacy experiment. Any later matched-G comparison is additional compute.

later_sft_scale_1400.purpose: Provisional research target; not an observed sufficient amount or collected inventory.
later_sft_scale_1400.token_warning: All token figures are arithmetic at 4k assistant loss tokens per successful trajectory; measure the actual Gemma tokenizer and masking before setting a compute budget. Input/tool tokens, repeated epochs and failed sampling are additional.

S.name: 编码、解析、序列化保真
S.evidence: 实际输入/输出跨表示转换；至少一个字段、字节数或往返语义反例。
S.exclude: 单纯依赖版本条件或对象协议识别。

S.name: 单位、坐标与跨度
S.evidence: 字节/码点/grapheme/cell/span的对应、边界与不丢失不变量。
S.exclude: 只改一个默认宽度常数。

S.name: 集合、多值与别名
S.evidence: 基数、顺序、重复项、字段命名空间在转换前后保持一致。
S.exclude: 共享列表被另一个请求污染。

S.name: 扫描、切分与遍历不变量
S.evidence: 终止、进度、覆盖、数量或宽度守恒；边界输入能区分旧/新行为。
S.exclude: 没有结构推理的一次局部if修复。

S.name: 嵌套表示与语法结构
S.evidence: 树/Schema/嵌套映射的转换、合法性与重建。

F.name: 参数、配置、元数据传播
F.evidence: 入口→转发或递归→消费者的缺边、继承或覆盖优先级。
F.exclude: 只有一个函数的默认值变化。

F.name: 引用、所有权与分支隔离
F.evidence: 对象身份、共享写入、copy时点及可观测污染路径。
F.exclude: 单纯列表到元组表示变换。

F.name: 缓存、作用域与失效
F.evidence: 缓存键/失效/跨请求状态的操作序列反例。
F.exclude: 仅判别对象是否支持某协议。

F.name: 资源、退出与取消
F.evidence: 打开-使用-关闭、yield/取消、所有者及释放时点的真实前后序列。

F.name: 启停、流式与事件时序
F.evidence: 启动、消费、结束跨阶段状态改变以及时序断言。

R.name: 注解、命名空间与泛型
R.evidence: globals/locals/ForwardRef/类型参数与实际反射结果。

R.name: callable、包装与partial
R.exclude: 同一对象的资源释放顺序。

R.name: 对象协议、代理与MRO
R.evidence: isinstance与真实能力、动态属性、继承分派之间的差异。

R.name: Python/依赖版本契约
R.evidence: 受支持版本之间的真实行为变化及修复适用条件。

R.name: 导入与运行时可用性
R.evidence: 导入顺序、lazy import、可选模块或动态属性的因果关系。

mechanism_inventory_available_now.note: Source completeness is not 96 instantiated environments or 96 successful trajectories. Human off-policy demonstration counts are recorded separately from on-policy and preference pairs.

exclusions.public_competition_129: Keep for capability profiling and development comparison; do not ingest as training data in this plan.
exclusions.reserved_evaluation: Exclude using authorized IDs/source manifests before body download; do not read heldout contents for matching.
exclusions.split_unit: Canonical repo/issue/PR plus related fix-chain/snapshot groups; split before generating trajectories; windows inherit their parent split.

verification_levels.source_verified: Publisher-provided success flag only; not independently verified here. Source identity and patch fields can be inconsistent and must be audited.
verification_levels.target_replayed: Actual behavior-preserving conversion and replay with our tool semantics and authentic observations; retain result and relevant command outputs.
verification_levels.patch_only: Task/gold diff or incomplete process; useful auxiliary material but not counted as a successful full agent trajectory.

protocol_requirements: Use actual Gemma tokenizer/chat template and official ADK tool schemas.
OpenHands persistent shell, file editors, polling and submit actions are not equivalent merely by renaming tools.
Retain exact raw provenance; never fabricate status/exit_code/observations for tools not replayed.
No future gold/test_patch/eval_logs in pre-action prompts.
Long trajectories need prefix-only context selection or recollection; no blind first-32k truncation.
Do not train protected-test/config tampering as a valid submission strategy.
No dedicated tests or gate scripts; use existing task tests and necessary one-off manual commands.

For action SFT, use the actual generation prefix, including pinned template add_generation_prompt and thinking settings; mask any forced empty thought controls as prompt. Preserve full-conversation rendering only as an audit archive.
